name: code-review-mcp-server

tools.name: codeReview
tools.description: Run a git diff between branches. Requires a base branch name to compare against the current branch, and provide instructions to review/fix issues.

folderPath.description: Path to the full root directory of the repository to run git diff

baseBranch.description: Name of the base branch to compare against the current branch (required). Specifies the reference point for diff comparison.

tools.name: getLocalGitDiff
tools.description: Get git diff between two branches locally. Returns raw diff output without review instructions.

folderPath.description: Path to the full root directory of the repository to run git diff

baseBranch.description: Name of the base branch to compare against the current branch (required). Specifies the reference point for diff comparison.

tools.name: codeReviewWithGithubUrl
tools.description: Run a git diff using a GitHub PR URL. Requires a GitHub pull request URL to fetch the diff, and provide instructions to review/fix issues.

url.description: A GitHub pull request URL to fetch the diff from (required).

tools.name: addPRSummaryComment
tools.description: Add a summary comment to a GitHub pull request

url.description: A GitHub pull request URL to add the comment to (required).

commentMessage.description: The comment message to add to the PR (required).

tools.name: addPRLineComment
tools.description: Add multiple comments to specific lines in a GitHub pull request

url.description: A GitHub pull request URL to add the comments to (required).

comments.description: Array of comments to add to specific lines in the PR (required). (Array<{filePath: string, line: string, commentMessage: string}>)

filePath.description: Path to the file in the repository to comment on.

line.description: Integer representing the specific line number to add a comment to. Must be a line that has been changed in the PR diff. Line ranges (e.g., "4-6") are not supported by GitHub API

commentMessage.description: The comment message to add to the PR (required).

tools.name: getPRTemplate
tools.description: Read PR template from specified folder path and template name, returns template content or default template if not found

folderPath.description: Path to the folder to search for PR template files

templateName.description: Name of the template file (optional, defaults to pull_request_template.md)

tools.name: createPR
tools.description: Create a new GitHub Pull Request with specified title, body, and branches. Automatically detects GitHub URL and current branch from local git configuration.

folderPath.description: Path to the git repository folder

githubUrl.description: GitHub repository URL (optional, auto-detected if not provided)

draft.description: Whether to create as draft PR (optional, defaults to false)

milestone.description: Milestone to assign to the PR (optional)
